settings.heading: Nasir Book Depot
settings.intro: Founded by Mr. Nasir Ahmed in 1988, Nasir Book Depot has served the Hazrat Nizamuddin community in New Delhi with Islamic books and religious items built on quality, reasonable prices, and reliable service.
settings.hero_image_alt: Islamic books and religious items at Nasir Book Depot
settings.story_heading: A Family Legacy Rooted In Service
settings.story_text: Nasir Book Depot began in Hazrat Nizamuddin, New Delhi, with a clear purpose: to make Islamic books and religious items available with dependable service and fair value. The work started by Mr. Nasir Ahmed continues as a family legacy, shaped by the trust of the community and a commitment to quality.
settings.side_note_text: Quality, reasonable prices, reliable service, and community trust.
settings.quote_text: A family legacy shaped by Islamic books, religious items, reasonable prices, and reliable service.
settings.commitment_text: We remain focused on offering Islamic books, Tasbeeh, Quran Sharif boxes, Rehal, and other religious items with care, reasonable prices, and reliable service.
